audit_basis: TASK_230 Part J: every shipped migration's upgrade() and downgrade() read in full; a downgrade is never called safe merely because downgrade() exists

reversible_without_data_loss.meaning: downgrade removes only structural objects (constraints, indexes) and the upgrade destroyed nothing

destructive_after_data.meaning: downgrade works before new data exists but drops data the application writes under the new schema

restore_backup_or_roll_forward_only.meaning: downgrade is lossy even without new data, rewrites or deletes retained rows, or removes the baseline schema

components.name: application
components.strategy: stop the candidate backend task (its Job Object ends the whole tree), rebind the task to the exact recorded previous action, start it and verify /health/live and /health/ready against the previous SHA and migration head

components.name: frontend_assets
components.strategy: rebind the frontend task to the previous immutable release and verify it serves that release's exact index.html and proxies to the previous backend

components.name: migration
components.strategy: no migration applied: nothing; every applied step reversible_without_data_loss and authorized: alembic downgrade to the recorded revision; otherwise automatic downgrade is forbidden: restore the validated pre-release backup by non-destructive swap when authorized, else MANUAL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED

components.name: collector
components.strategy: rebind the Sentinel task to the exact recorded previous action; its schedule contract (one 06:00:00 trigger) is verified unchanged

components.name: scheduled_task
components.strategy: only actions are rebound; triggers, settings and principal are proven identical to the recorded definition; tasks are never registered or removed by a release
